author: DNAlpha123321DN
quote: This game was bad. Just bad. Can't steal cars in some places in a game called grand theft auto, can't shoot particular npcs, forced to buy groceries and buy flowers for your girl, boring story, no humor or comedy in this game, also having a honor system in a game which is about violence is bs. Rockstar wants you to shoot them in the legs to incapacitated them because if you shoot them in the head you get low honor and get a **** ending. I like the idea of a Bonnie and Clyde protagonists but come on this game is bs. Also you can't get prostitutes in 6 to focus on their relationship according to rockstar. But you can go to a strip club to get a lap dance. Also, in gta 5, michael is married but can still get prostitutes even after reuniting the family. I'm not saying jason is a cuck or it's woke, I'm saying that this game has zero soul or guts. What happened to Sam Houser? He has lost his passion many years ago. Ever since lazlow and Dan Houser left, rockstar has gone to ****. Gta online warned us about 6. Those **** dlcs they released, the kortz center heist, the los Santos drug wars, the los Santos tuners, the chop shop, they were a warning. Rockstar does not care about the fans, they care about shark cards and online. Gta is dead. The franchise is dead. I'm even more worried about future titles. Well done rockstar. I'm ashamed. And being unable to replay missions is just bs aswell
